proof.text: Former clients include the Portland Trail Blazers, Seattle Seahawks, LA Clippers, Detroit Lions, Seattle Kraken, SF Giants and New Balance.
Work across the NFL, NBA, MLB, WNBA, NHL, MLS, NCAA, NWSL, MiLB, WHL and PGA Tour.
Members grow from consultant to Project Manager.
Spring 2026 clients: Seattle Mariners, Portland Trail Blazers, Spokane Zephyr.
Fall 2026 clients: Minnesota Vikings, Chicago Sky, Houston Astros, Gonzaga Athletics.
Portland trip: Nike World HQ with Zag alumni, consulting for the Trail Blazers on B2B strategy, presenting at the Moda Center.
The Portland team evaluated the Moda Center ticket-buyer experience and the partnership value of sponsored ticket packages.
An advisory council of industry professionals, chaired by founder Mateo Valdez ('23).

do: Facts over adjectives: name the client, the venue, the work
dont: Never invent clients, numbers, quotes or results
No client logos unless the client rules allow it
No claims about outcomes a client hasn't approved

workshop.q: In one sentence, what is GSCG?
What makes us different from other student consulting groups and sport business programs?
Why should a student choose Gonzaga because of GSCG?
What can a team count on when it works with us?
What 3 to 5 things do we want to be known for? (These become the content buckets.)
Which results can we share publicly? (client outcomes, internships, jobs, alumni placements)
Which clients can we name, and which logos are cleared?
Three words that describe how we sound. Anything we never say?

audienceQuestions: What do they need to believe about GSCG?
What's the one message they should remember?
What do we want them to do next?
